description: This file defines an interface 'PredicateVisitor' for the Eclipse Ditto project, providing methods to visit various predicate types for query criteria, following the visitor design pattern.

classes.name: PredicateVisitor
classes.description: An interface for visiting different types of predicates in query criteria, enabling structured processing or interpretation of predicates.

methods.name: visitEq
methods.description: Visit method for equality predicate with a value.

methods.name: visitGe
methods.description: Visit method for greater than or equal predicate.

methods.name: visitGt
methods.description: Visit method for greater than predicate.

methods.name: visitIn
methods.description: Visit method for 'in' predicate with a list of values.

methods.name: visitLe
methods.description: Visit method for less than or equal predicate.

methods.name: visitLike
methods.description: Visit method for pattern matching predicate.

methods.name: visitLt
methods.description: Visit method for less than predicate.

methods.name: visitNe
methods.description: Visit method for not equal predicate.
